blockers.description: Tauri IPC invoke() returns undefined when app is accessed via web browser instead of Tauri desktop context. The app uses Tauri commands (add_proxy, update_proxy_pool_config, assign_domain_proxy) which require the Tauri runtime to function. agent-browser cannot test Tauri apps through web browser access.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: 1) Tried connecting to Tauri app via CDP port 9222 - Tauri CLI does not support --remote-debugging-port flag. 2) Tried launching Tauri binary directly with --remote-debugging-port - port not exposed. 3) Verified all Tauri IPC calls fail with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'transformCallback')' error.

blockers.description: Alternative testing approach needed: Tauri apps require either (a) native OS automation tools, (b) Tauri's built-in testing framework with WebDriver, or (c) mocking the Tauri IPC layer for browser-based testing
blockers.quickFixAttempted: None - requires infrastructure changes beyond validator scope

summary: Tested 2 assertions: 0 passed, 0 failed, 2 blocked. Both assertions are blocked by fundamental infrastructure limitation: Tauri apps cannot be tested via web browser automation because the Tauri IPC layer (window.__TAURI__) is not available outside the Tauri desktop app context. The per-domain assignment UI code exists and appears correctly implemented (per-domain-assignment.tsx with SUPPORTED_DOMAINS for gmail.com, yahoo.com, hotmail.com), but cannot be exercised through agent-browser. Recommendation: Use Tauri's WebDriver testing framework or implement a mock IPC layer for browser-based testing.
